name: Frozen shoulder — freezing stage
for: Frozen shoulder (adhesive capsulitis), the painful first months
blurb: Gentle range of motion, pain-free, twice a day. The range is set low on purpose; a little more each week is the aim, never force.
notes: Warm the shoulder first — a shower or a warm pack for ten minutes.
Every movement to the point of stretch, not pain. Pain that lasts more than an hour after means it was too much.
Twice a day. Little and often beats one long session.
Freezing can last two to nine months; the thawing programme follows when the pain settles and only stiffness is left.

sources.title: Harvard Health — stretching exercises for frozen shoulder

items.note: Small circles; let the body do the swinging.
As high as is comfortable; the range is set low.
A few inches of turn. No band yet.
The shoulder will hike a little while it is sore: not called here.
